+"""Camera-guided controller for this single hand-insert episode."""
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+def observe(robot, label):
+    cams = list(robot.spec()["cameras"])
+    result = robot.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True)
+    out = Path("/app/runs") / label
+    result.save(out)
+    print(label, "tcp", result.meta["proprio"]["now"][:4],
+          "target", result.meta["task"]["target_pos"],
+          "steps", result.meta["control_steps"], flush=True)
+    return result
+
+
+def move(robot, displacement, grip, label, gain=0.8):
+    """Move the mocap target in small native steps, then settle."""
+    displacement = np.asarray(displacement, dtype=float)
+    n = int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(displacement)) / (0.01 * gain)))
+    actions = np.zeros((max(1, n) + 15, 4), dtype=np.float64)
+    if n:
+        actions[:n, :3] = displacement / (0.01 * n)
+    actions[:, 3] = grip
+    result = robot.submit("ee_delta", actions, dt=robot.spec()["control_dt"],
+                          cameras=list(robot.spec()["cameras"]),
+                          include_depth=True, video="frames", note=label)
+    result.save(Path("/app/runs") / label)
+    print(label, "tcp", result.meta["proprio"]["now"][:4],
+          "steps", result.meta["control_steps"], flush=True)
+    return result
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    robot = Robot()
+    stage = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "observe"
+    if stage == "clear":
+        move(robot, [0.12, -0.02, 0.05], -1, "clear")
+    else:
+        observe(robot, stage)
*** End Patch";
